critical_errors: use of incorrect formula (e.g. circumference = diameter)
failure to provide units for answer
misconceptions: thinking that circumference is the same as diameter
not understanding relationship between circumference and diameter
grading_notes: answer must be in decimal form with one digit after comma. Only answer given to 1 decimal place would get full marks, while answers given to more than two decimal places (e.g. .509) will get half mark or no marks at all if they are wrong.
